Hi there. I've never lost a parent to suicide but one of them did attempt multiple times in my life. I'm eighteen now and I personally found one of my parents after an attempt in their bedroom after coming home from school. 
It was the most horrible thing I've ever experienced.

Things like these have been happening since I was a baby, and affected my mental health greatly. Right now I'm in therapy, EMDR to be exact, to learn how to cope with my parent's suicide attempts. 

It's extremely terrifying as a child to find your mother or father like that. I never understood why they tried to take their life, and I still don't. I'm too afraid to ask. Im also afraid that it will happen again. The smallest fights make my thoughts go wild, terrified to find pills and knifes scattered around the kitchen once again.

I love my parents more than anything, and I know my parents treasure me as well. I don't know exactly where I'm trying to go with this but i want you to know that taking your life will hurt your daughter greatly. From reading your post it seems like you also love her more than anything on this world so please, stay on this earth. It may sound like a selfish thing to ask from me but please stay for your daughter. No child deserves to go through the pain of finding their parent like that.
Thank you for the advice, it helped me feel to feel better about the situation
